name: OMNI Economic Participation
purpose: Compose economic participation across trade, markets, investment, exchange, sourcing, capacity, logistics and settlement using canonical ecosystem capabilities.
authority_model: Consumes scoped human/entity authority and canonical authorization; matching/readiness never grant authority.
data_model: Canonical identity, relationship, offer/order/transaction/event/evidence records with provenance and historical identifiers.
evidence_model: Negotiation, supply, inspection, handoff and settlement evidence remains linked to the causal event chain.
economic_model: Economic domain composition; not a replacement for universal Value or I/O semantics.
pulse_model: Emits outcome and value observations through canonical Pulse pathways.
continuity_model: Preserve commitments, evidence, obligations and events across retries, provider changes and product exit.
exit_handoff: Export canonical participant, capability, obligation, transaction, evidence and event references to OMNII/HAPI/I-O receiving capabilities.
